errors.message: + can't be used with STRING values
errors.hint: + works on numbers. To join text, use &.

notes: Wording for E-CHK-OPERAND-TYPE in Edexcel (first version, for review in docs/review/M2.md). No spec row says + on a STRING is an error; arithmetic is defined on numbers only (edexcel.md 2.4, EDX-13), so it is a checker error at the operator. MISC: see docs/review/M2.md. Decision D4 in docs/review/M2.md.
